exit 0
--- stdout
Generate the autocompletion script for the fish shell.
To load completions in your current shell session:
liza completion fish | source
To load completions for every new session, execute once:
liza completion fish > ~/.config/fish/completions/liza.fish
You will need to start a new shell for this setup to take effect.
Usage:
liza completion fish [flags]
Flags:
-h, --help help for fish
--no-descriptions disable completion descriptions
Global Flags:
--check-update check for a Liza update before running
-C, --project-root string Liza project root for state commands
--update-channel string update check channel: stable or main (default "stable")
-v, --verbose verbose output
--- stderr
